explication: Telepresence connects a developer’s workstation to Kubernetes, then attaches local code to remote workloads. The principal flow is: CLI command → user daemon/session → traffic-manager coordination → workload agent attachment → tunneled traffic and cluster networking → local process receives service traffic. The same control plane also supports filtered intercepts, replacement, wiretap, ingest, DNS, remote volumes, QUIC transport, authentication, and sidecar or node-agent attachment. Some control-flow links are inferred from documented interfaces because most implementations were not sampled.
